allow: PowerShell(Write-Output "=== Tous les processus tex/mikt/pdf ==="; Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match "tex|mikt|pdf" } | Select-Object ProcessName, Id, MainWindowTitle; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== Contenu C:\\Users\\HP\\AppData\\Local\\MiKTeX \(3 niveaux\) ==="; Get-ChildItem "C:\\Users\\HP\\AppData\\Local\\MiKTeX" -Recurse -Depth 3 -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match "lock|lck|packages|cache" } | Select-Object FullName, @{N='KB';E={[math]::Round\($_.Length/1KB,1\)}}, LastWriteTime; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== Contenu C:\\Users\\HP\\AppData\\Roaming\\MiKTeX \(3 niveaux\) ==="; Get-ChildItem "C:\\Users\\HP\\AppData\\Roaming\\MiKTeX" -Recurse -Depth 3 -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match "lock|lck|packages|cache" } | Select-Object FullName, @{N='KB';E={[math]::Round\($_.Length/1KB,1\)}}, LastWriteTime)

PowerShell(Write-Output "=== initexmf --report COMPLET ==="; & initexmf --report 2>&1; Write-Output ""; Write-Output "=== ProgramData MiKTeX ==="; if \(Test-Path "$env:ProgramData\\MiKTeX"\) { Get-ChildItem "$env:ProgramData\\MiKTeX" -Recurse -Depth 4 -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match "lock|lck|\\.bin$" } | Select-Object FullName, @{N='KB';E={[math]::Round\($_.Length/1KB,1\)}}, LastWriteTime | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 20 } else { "Pas de ProgramData\\MiKTeX" })
